Programming Language Reference: C++
Version: ISO/IEC 14882:2020 (C++20 / C++23)
Syntax: Multi-paradigm language extending C with classes, templates, exceptions, namespaces, operator overloading, and RAII.
Semantics: High-performance native compilation, zero-overhead abstraction principle, deterministic object destruction.
Type System: Statically typed, nominal subtyping, compile-time metaprogramming via templates and concepts (C++20).
Memory Model: RAII with smart pointers (std::unique_ptr, std::shared_ptr), move semantics (std::move, rvalue references &&).
Concurrency: std::thread, std::jthread, std::async, std::atomic, std::mutex, condition variables, coroutines (C++20).
Error Handling: Exception handling via try/catch/throw, std::expected (C++23), std::optional.
Standard APIs: std::vector, std::unordered_map, std::string, std::filesystem, std::ranges, std::format
Specification: ISO/IEC 14882 Standard
Official Docs: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp
